name: Vita (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Vita (a tree, tools and waves on green).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 31 December 2013 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 134 of 15 July 2014); the flag is a rectangular cloth of 3:2 (length by width) divided vertically into two stripes, green at the hoist and yellow at the fly, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Vita arms — tree, tools and waves
